notes.title: A Sneak Peek at ATONE Combat and Music
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/38993a11746e685279592e53ebfab7d29aaa5bb9.png

Hello Midgardians!

ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree, the upcoming title from our friends at Untold Tales and Wildboy Studios, launches in just 10 short days, so we wanted to provide a nice snippet of combat and a preview of the incredible soundtrack that awaits you. 

FIGHT TO THE BEAT

Combat is all about surviving to the end of the song. Let's have a quick look at a battle against the Ice King in Hard Mode.

[previewyoutube=rv55TIzzBgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep focused and stick to the rhythm and you'll land a strike. But make too many mistakes and it'll cost you! 

If you find yourself struggling or unable to vanquish your enemies, there's always Normal Moe which makes the notes appear on 2 rails only. There is also Story Mode, where combat is entirely winnable, every time, allowing you to focus on the incredible narrative.

All fights can then be replayed in the Arena Mode for those wanting that perfect score or certain trophies.

A TASTE OF THE TUNES

We've also got a little sneak peak at the amazing in-game OST, composed by the talented James Shuar also know in the electronica scene as Luminist, as well as contributions from composer Andrew Prahlow (The Outer Wilds). 

Have a listen to "Sons of Fenrir" and transport yourself to the wilds of ATONE.

[previewyoutube=ls_CZHd7p_M;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree joins Untold Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/4005a0aa7ce0f645ef6de4804fc79f41f34448ac.png

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

New Publisher
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: Untold Tales! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> 

Release Window
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in early 2023. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

Next Fest Demo Available Now
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620

If you enjoyed what you played, please wishlist and spread the word, as that helps immensely to increase awareness. Be sure to follow our social channels below for all news and future updates on ATONE.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtaleshq

Cheers!
Wildboy Studios and Untold Tales

notes.title: Let's continue to explore the characters & creatures of Aspire: Ina's Tale!
notes.content:
Last time we introduced you to the mother of The Tower, The Architect, as well as our protagonist herself, Ina.

Today we take a look at the one-time Chief of Security at the Tower, The Guiding Light. We're also going to take a peek at the cutest creatures in Aspire: Ina's Tale, The Flumye.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41064623/b25f592de467cb2bcb8c4cb9574b8bf6029890c2.png 

The Guiding Light was once called Justice and was the one in charge of security and enforcement within The Tower. His duties, however, were deemed far too terrible, and over time they took their toll. 

Justice could no longer take it so they went through a metamorphosis of sorts, taking on a new shape and name.  They then began to wander The Tower as The Guiding Light, to help those in need, instead of punishing those who dared to trespass.   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41064623/69294930f5a4fcef2be892b5f61cc7bb24097bce.png                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       

There used to be many kinds of Flumyes, each created for a specific purpose, but now very few specimens remain. 

These small machine-like beings were made using the souls of those ensnared by The Tower. Never has something so sinister looked so cute.

They are portable sources of magical light and energy.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Stay with us as we'll be uncovering more characters soon.

Also, we'd love for you to wishlist the game and share it with your friends, as it really helps us as an indie studio.

By the way, the demo is still available, so you can have a look at the dazzling Tower right now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1720090/Aspire_Inas_Tale/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41064623/95440cbc7b7264c8e07e0a4603d6583859365fa2.png

Link: https://discord.gg/aCHvcc7SjN

Thanks for all your support, and see you around!
- Team Untold Tales

notes.title: Join us as we spotlight the characters of Aspire: Ina's Tale!
notes.content:
We're happy to give you a first glimpse of the main characters!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41064623/5d8820ea853de4908f1300dc2744eda45631f0d3.png
Ina
Originally from Kamiura, a tiny village in the outskirts of the Silvery Sea, Ina was raised by her father to become a priestess in his stead. 

Sweet and generous, she was always ready to help those in need, but it was her dreamer nature that drew the Towers attention, as it called to her and took her away from her family. Now, all she wants is to leave this dreadful place and return home. 

Her arch goes from a scared little girl to a self-assured young woman, and represents the very essence of the title "Aspire": how can we become more than we already are?

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41064623/107388a3e0c8c89de261bb97979eabfa3fc26462.png
The Architect
The Architect is a proud mother: she may not have given birth to the Tower, but she was the one who shaped it, molded its paths and geography.

Therein lies the dubious nature of their relationship: the Architect is aware of the Tower's predatory nature, but she is proud nonetheless - of her work, her creations, and their development. She is thorough and meticulous, but also caring and affectionate.

---

Stay with us as we'll be uncovering more characters soon.

Also, we'd love for you to wishlist the game and share it with your friends, as it really helps us as an indie studio.

Wake up dreamers.

Untold Tales along with our friends over at Wondernaut Studio are super proud to announce the evocative yet delicately twisted Aspire: Ina’s Tale. A monstrous tower feeds off the dreams of its prisoners. It's up to Ina to find out why and how to break free.
